message.content: This magazine cover features the red title "TEMPO" across the top. Below it, the headline reads "KOALISI HIRUK-PIKUK," followed by the smaller text "Rangkul dan tolak di seputar hari pencoblosan. Politik dua muka partai tengah." The date "7-13 APRIL 2014" and the price "RP 35.000" are visible. The central illustration depicts a dense crowd of men. In the foreground, a man in a white button-down shirt holds a thin, yellow, cylindrical flute horizontally to his mouth. In the upper right, another man in a similar white shirt plays an identical flute. Surrounding them are numerous men with expressive facial features; some are shouting, smiling, or looking at each other. Many have their arms raised with clenched fists or open palms. One man in an orange shirt in the lower right foreground wears a detailed wristwatch. Another man nearby wears dark-rimmed glasses and a beard. In the background, tall, light-colored rectangular buildings rise against a clear blue sky. Other legible text includes "INGKAR JANJI SAMURAI GULA" and "PEMERASAN DAN ANCAMAN KASUS PLN BELAWAN" at the top.
